note: Population health indicators. Life expectancy: CDC/NCHS NVSS (2020-2024 verified; earlier from CDC/Historical Statistics; small revisions possible). Infant mortality: deaths per 1,000 live births (CDC). Maternal mortality: deaths per 100,000 live births (CDC; peer OECD ~3-8). Healthcare spending: % of GDP (CMS NHE; 2024 verified 18.0%). Uninsured: % of population (Census CPS). Peer comparison: US life expectancy ~79 vs high-income peer average ~82-84 (OECD).

infant_mortality_per_1000.note: Roughly halved 1990-2010; plateau since. Peer average ~3-4.

maternal_mortality_per_100k.note: US ~18-33 in recent years (2021 spike 32.9; 2023 18.6); peer countries ~3-8. Approximate; pregnancy-related definition revisions affect comparability.

drug_overdose_deaths_thousands.note: Epidemic: prescription opioids 1990s-2000s, heroin 2010s, fentanyl 2015+, stimulants recent. 2024-25 declining. Approximate.

suicide_rate_per_100k.note: Peak 2018 (14.2); declined modestly since; still elevated vs 2000 (10.4).

adult_obesity_pct.note: NHANES; 2018 ~42% (CDC definition change); peer countries typically 15-25%.

uninsured_rate_pct.note: ACA (2014+) cut uninsured roughly in half; recent ~8%. Approximate values.

cancer_mortality_trend.note: Declining ~1.5-2%/yr since early 1990s (smoking + treatment advances); approx benchmarks.
